subject.title: [Bug] cacheRetention has no effect on Discord direct-message sessions; subagent/cron/channel sessions cache normally

question: Should maintainers require a live MiniMax M3 Discord direct-message cache probe before authorizing a fix path for this issue?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the relevant paths but does not identify the first failing boundary or prove current-main provider cache behavior, and the needed evidence depends on external Discord and MiniMax credentials.

options.title: Run live cache probe first
options.body: Collect a redacted 3-turn MiniMax M3 trace for Discord DM, Discord channel, cron, and subagent sessions before choosing a code fix.

options.title: Investigate source-only
options.body: Allow a maintainer to start with a source-level hypothesis, accepting a higher risk of fixing the wrong cache boundary.

options.title: Wait for reporter data
options.body: Keep the issue open until the reporter posts the offered focused 3-call cache probe and sessions diff.

recommendation.title: Run live cache probe first
recommendation.body: Collect a redacted 3-turn MiniMax M3 trace for Discord DM, Discord channel, cron, and subagent sessions before choosing a code fix.
